# `FixMax` Namespace

<p>The maximum value or size encodable in "Fix" variants of formats. <a href="#details">More...</a></p>

## Definition

<div class="doxyDefinition">
namespace llvm::msgpack::FixMax { ... }
</div>

## Description {#details}

<p>The maximum value or size encodable in "Fix" variants of formats.</p>


<p>For example, FixStr objects encode their size in the five least significant bits of their first byte, so the largest encodable size is 0b00011111.</p>
